entities.summary: Subedar Major and Honorary Captain Yogendra Singh Yadav PVC is a retired Indian military officer, who was awarded India's highest military award, the Param Vir Chakra, for his actions during the Kargil War. He is the youngest recipient of the Param Vir Chakra to date, having received it at the age of 19.
